description: One tool call from the model through the session (core/session.js executeTool), in this order: request_tool; unknown or denied; the master switch; the tool is off; not on this page; unreadable arguments; invalid arguments; the confirmation; the run. The scripted session: settings = sanitizeSettings(input.settings) (save() merges toolStates); the page { id, title, content } (content: a string; a tool with "setContent" replaces it when it runs) and input.app as context, snapshots stamped 2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z; input.tools are tool definitions whose run returns "result" (absent: nothing), or throws Error("throws") when that is set; input.agents are agent files { file, text }, input.skills skill files { folder, text } (no folder on disk), input.permissions the application policy, input.memory the starting notes (a memory store, when given), input.screen a screenshot source (true, or { needsGesture }) that returns a 1280 x 720 JPEG with id "shot1"; the default prompt is "B"; no image attachments. The user answers the cards with input.answers in order (then each card's decline; "cancel" also stops the question), and input.allowedForChat are the tools already allowed for this chat. Output: the result for the model, the rows the view was asked to show (title, call, the statuses in order, a label, a screenshot, an Undo), the cards (kind, button ids, tool, reason; for a confirmation the permission decision and a built-in's own confirm data), the notices, the tools that actually ran with their arguments, the tool states, screenshotAuto, the tools allowed for this chat and the memory afterwards, and the action records.
operation: session = scripted(input); session.executeTool(input.call, { reply, signal, actions }) -> { result, rows, cards, notices, ran, toolStates, screenshotAuto, allowedForChat, memory?, actions }
